bugs.title: Stop bit is one clock short (CLKS_PER_BIT-1 cycles); tx_ready rises a cycle early
bugs.spec_clause: Each bit lasts exactly CLKS_PER_BIT cycles ... tx_ready rises again in the first cycle after the stop bit.
bugs.evidence: First mismatch at cycle 42: tx_ready=1, expected 0 (frame accepted 40 cycles earlier; start and data bits match, the stop bit lasts 3 clocks instead of 4). On back-to-back frames the next start bit begins one cycle early (txd=0, expected 1 at cycle 43).

summary: Found a DUT bug: the stop bit is CLKS_PER_BIT-1 clocks. The reference model was kept faithful to the spec; it fails on this DUT and passes on the correct uart_tx.
